module: Flowgraph node "Rally Loop Chained Mission Setup" (category once_instant, tag rally, no pin). Prepares the next mission of the rally loop after an execution transfer: sets the transfer flag to false (gameplay_rallyLoop.setMissionExecutionTransferFlag(false)) then calls gameplay_rallyLoop.setupForNewMission(). When the graph stops, unloads the rally loop extension unless an execution transfer is in progress.

_executionStopped.desc: Unloads the rally loop extension if it is loaded and no mission execution transfer is signaled.

workOnce.desc: Resets the transfer flag and calls setupForNewMission if gameplay_rallyLoop exists.
